quest.title: Hiromi's Watch
quest.description: Commission Officer Hiromi seems to be vexed about something. Perhaps he could use some help...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: None of your business.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll... let you go this time. Just please, leave me alone.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: ... Why'd you come again? If you got something to say, hurry up!

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Don't interrupt a man while he's waiting for someone!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Waiting for someone far outside his realm of jurisdiction?

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: What are you trying to say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not some proper folk you're meeting then, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: O—Of course I wouldn't... Are you questioning a public servant?

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: I'm on duty and waiting for my informant... a contact...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Speak up, I can barely hear you anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Ugh, enough! Leave, or you'll be coming with me to the Outlander Affairs Agency on charges of obstructing a personnel on official duty!

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Are you not afraid of being deported by the Commissioner?

choices.text: I feel like yours is the more evident misdemeanor.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: ...Please don't report this matter to the Commissioner.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: But... I still don't get it. What is it that you want to know?

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: I'm just a low-ranking officer. I don't know much beyond my duties. I don't think I'll be of much help to you.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: I... can't believe an outlander would understand the honor of a samurai. You have my respect...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ah, a public servant and a honeyed tongue.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Alright, please don't mock me anymore. I sincerely apologize for my rudeness. Please accept my apology.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: By the way, I don't believe that you've given me your name...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #Call me {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: #Well, {NICKNAME}, since you're willing to help, I do have something to ask of you.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Here's how it is. I have a childhood friend — an outlander — whom I haven't been able to meet since the Sakoku Decree came into effect.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: I was worried about her safety, so I started putting letters into drifting bottles in hopes that she'd receive them.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: However, she still hasn't responded.

choices.text: I just can't stand the way you're going on like this.
Why, yes! Let's go, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: If you have anything to say, please talk to my senior disciple. I know you don't like listening to me anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: Hmph... No one likes to listen to me...

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: This is it! Her badge is inside, too.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: I don't know how to thank you enough...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You wouldn't mind me reading it, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Eh? What? Please don't...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Do you still remember the Uyuu Restaurant?"

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "We shall meet there... "

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Wait—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "You will find money for wine attached herein."

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Okay—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "But if you are not the one I was expecting to receive this letter..."

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: #Please stop reading it! {NICKNAME}, that was very, incredibly rude of you!

choices.text: Look at you, being all serious.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Stop messing around! If you want to help me, just say so!

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: So recently, one of her... old friends told me that she is doing well. They're both adventurers exploring the world, so I trust his intel.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Unfortunately, between all the duties I shoulder, it's impossible for me to venture that far out...

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: I was going to ask him to deliver my letter for me, and we agreed to meet here.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: But all he ever thinks about is treasure. He hurriedly left for the ancient ruins on the northern part of Narukami Island... and I haven't heard from him since.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: I've been here several times already, finding time every day to wait for him here. But I can't keep making excuses to sneak off.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: #That's why I was hoping that you could accompany me to find him, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: I suspect that it would take me a lot of time just to find those ruins, were I to go by myself.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: But with your help, we may yet save a lot of time.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: By the way, since you already have the bottle... you can hand it over to her as well.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, can I count on you for this?

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Aye aye, let's head out at once!

choices.text: Were you like that when you were writing these letters, too?

talks.objective: Go to the north of Narukami Island to find traces of Shun

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: Huh? Why are you here? And who's that you've brought along?

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: Didn't we agree to meet alone?

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: Eh, I understand. But if it's about "that case," then tell your colleagues that it's not time yet.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: This isn't about that... it's the matter from last week. The one you promised me about.

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: Oh? Not that case? Then which one are you talking about? I'm a law-abiding citizen these days, you know! I'm squeaky clean!

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: This isn't the time we agreed on, either way. I mean, I just got out of jail two weeks ago.

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, I've got it now... are you trying to preemptively arrest me to gain some credit?

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: No, that's not it at all... And what gain would there be in catching someone like you?

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: Ouch! Not in the feelings, man! I'm at least a Treasure Hoarder Cadre. I'll have you know that I'm pretty well-known on the streets, too!

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: No, wait, I get it now! You must be—

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: *sigh*

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Man, not even knowing who the Treasure Hoarders are... Is your colleague over here new or something?

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Shut up.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: #Listen, {NICKNAME}. Shun is my informant. Please, don't make an unnecessary fuss out of this.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Look, Shun, I came here with this outl— I mean, friend of mine, to ask you about where "Big Sis" is. I... I want to get in touch with her again.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Oh... Hahahahhaha!

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: What on earth are you laughing at, huh? What's your issue?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yeah, what he said.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Hahaha, you're hilarious!

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: So here's the skinny, Traveler. The three of us have known each other since we were wetting beds.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: This was back before the Sakoku Decree. Way before Hiromi became some stick-in-the-mud, too.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: *sigh* I mean, just look at what the Commission headquarters did to a good boy like him.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: With me, they turned a good boy into a public servant who protects the people. With him, they turned a bad boy into a Treasure Hoarder.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Alright, alright, I'll be straight with you. See, you knew who we were before the Sakoku Decree was implemented, right?

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: There you have it: that's why she left Inazuma.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Bet you wrote about Uyuu Restaurant in your last letter, eh? Don't worry, I miss it too.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: We even had a drink there the day before the Sakoku Decree took effect.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Everyone could tell what you were thinking, trust me.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: But well, isn't it a crying shame that your Shogun hates outlander drifters, eh?

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: ...Let's just get back to business.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Is any of this business?

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Alright, I'm done messing with you. And I'd love to help you too, but... I don't think I can.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: What do you mean?

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: ...It's a long story.

choices.text: Oh, look, my hand is itching! I think it wants to beat someone up!

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Wow, a coincidence. Mine does too!

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: So, "Big Sis" and I were in Jueyun Karst not long ago. You know about Jueyun Karst, right?

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Home of the adepti, shiny golden Cor Lapis, light blue Noctilucous Jade, the works...

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: That's where all the rare and exotic treasures gifted by heaven are buried, you know? They say that the adepti...

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Oh, okay, okay. So "Big Sis" and I were casing Jueyun Karst... Everything was going well at first, and we were even able to conceal ourselves from the adepti...

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: We planned on treating ourselves to something nice after casing that joint, and we were just about to head back...

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: And then there was a whistling cry between the rocks and the sea, and two swords were drawn!

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Two people leapt in front of us — one man and one woman — yelling "Bandits! There's nowhere to run!"

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: It was a pair of warriors from the Guhua Clan! That was it, we thought — we were done for! Oh yeah, and y'know, I've heard that man is named...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Get. To. The. Point!

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: So the man's called Sun Yu and the woman's called Little Que'er.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: "Big Sis" and I had to split right there. I've got no clue where she is now.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}! You saved me a lot of time there...

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: The scope of our search has been narrowed down a lot. All you need to do now is... check with those two members of the Guhua Clan, and there should be hope of finding her yet.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: This bottle and her badge... I can only rest easy after I've returned both of these to her.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, I'm embarrassed to ask, but can you please help me out?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're not going yourself?

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: I... I have other duties. It will be hard for me to leave.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Ooh, "I have other duties." Aah, "It will be hard for me to leave~"

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Hmph. You're useless!

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: How can you take yourself seriously, what with your pathetic salary and having to flatter your superiors constantly?

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: It's getting late, anyway. You should go back to your post.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Ah, I don't know what to say... You want to be a good public servant and a lackey of the Commissioner...

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Yet you can't let go of our friendship or forget the throbbing of your heart...

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Even though your paths have diverged so much.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: You don't have the guts to make your own choices. You're just a wuss who throws your duties to others.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: ...But don't you worry, those choices will come back to you in the end.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: When that time comes, you won't be able to hide anymore.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: ...Don't you lecture me.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: That's right, that's right! How could I forget! I'm an outlander thief, and you're a public servant. You should be the one lecturing me!

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: Well, Traveler, looks like it's your time to save the day again.

response.speaker: Shun
response.text: I'm not gonna play house with this petty public servant a second longer. I've got my own job to do.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: No, I'm fine. I'm fine.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Well, he wasn't speaking complete nonsense.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: #But I'm afraid that I still need you to do this for me, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: You're as stubborn as a mule.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Thanks... I will seize the next opportunity when it comes along with my own hands.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: #Well, I'd best be back soon, or my superior will get mad. Thanks again for your help, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Take care of yourself! If anything urgent should crop up, you know where to find me in Ritou.

choices.text: An explanation would be nice, Hiromi.

talks.objective: Go to Jueyun Karst to search for Sun Yu and Little Que'er

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you, Traveler. Your great name is known throughout Liyue Harbor. Might I inquire as to why you have elected to grace us with your...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're talking all funny.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Ah. I am presently trying to teach Que'er how to treat people with the proper etiquette. As the saying goes, "Those without credibility have no leg to stand on, and those without etiquette..."

choices.text: Fair, but there's no need to be so formal.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Alright. Then, may I help you?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm looking for a certain female thief.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Oh, so you have come to perform the chivalrous act of hunting down criminals. The Guhua Clan will definitely support that! What aid may we lend you?

choices.text: The two of you went after her once.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Now that you mention it, I do have an impression of just such an incident.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: It happened about a week ago. Que'er and I were wandering these mountains and training when we were interrupted by two thieves.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: We rose up and made to help the adepti keep their paradise clean of such unwanted intruders...

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: We pursued the two thieves deep into Mt. Hulao, only to see their shadows suddenly rise and fall, rise and fall...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Then what happened...?

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Suddenly, one of the shadows disappeared. I said, "Que'er, this must be a trap! Don't fall for it!" Then we began to chase the female thief...

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: We climbed Mt. Hulao through rock, stone, cave, and cloud...

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: In short, we chased them up and down, up and down, and up and down...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Uh huh. And then...?

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: We heard a *puff*!

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: And then the female thief was gone.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Little Que'er and I searched for her for a long time, but we couldn't find any trace. We thought that she must have fallen off the cliffs.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Or perhaps she was so agile that she gave us the slip. That's possible as well.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: That's all I know. I cannot be sure if it'll be of use to you, but...

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Ah, I am glad that we were able to help! By the way, I also saw a few Qingxin on the mountain's summit that seemed quite lovely — beyond the pale, even. I wonder if...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Taking my leave now!

choices.text: Do you still have any impression of her?

talks.objective: Go to Mt. Hulao to search for traces of "Big Sis"

dialogues.speaker: Yan'er
dialogues.text: So, I suppose that you've got something you need my help with, then!

choices.text: Oh, I was just passing through.

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: Hah! You can't fool me.

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: You outlanders have faces that can hide no secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Yan'er
dialogues.text: *cough* *cough* *panting* Phew, thought I'd never get out!

dialogues.speaker: Yan'er
dialogues.text: Thanks for saving my life, stranger...?

dialogues.speaker: Yan'er
dialogues.text: Eh!? It's you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're...

dialogues.speaker: Yan'er
dialogues.text: Aren't you that... that... !

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, so it's "that"...

dialogues.speaker: Yan'er
dialogues.text: Yes! And that time in Qingce, too... that...!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah. Definitely "that."

dialogues.speaker: Yan'er
dialogues.text: Yes! That's right! So... did you get any mileage out of those Chi remains?

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: Ah—hahahaha!

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: Ah, you're something, alright. So it really was you who turned my brothers inside-out back in Qingce Village.

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: Well, regardless, you have my thanks for saving my life.

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: Otherwise, I don't know how long I would have been trapped in this accursed amber. It was awful in there...

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: The vaunted adepti of Jueyun Karst — a pack of petty jerks, I tell you!

choices.text: The adeptus saved your life, you know.

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: Hehe, you're right.

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: I accidentally fell into this pit back when I was trying to avoid that crazy couple.

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: But thanks to Mountain Spitter wrapping me up in amber from way over in his abode, I wasn't injured.

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: Well, he's not an avid finisher of what he starts, seeing as how he didn't let me out afterwards.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The adeptus was probably trying to punish you, too.

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: Makes sense, hahaha!

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: Alright, alright. I'm done laughing now. Come on, let's get out of this place.

choices.text: Just saying, you're still in their territory.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: #So, {NICKNAME}, do you have any news?

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: I see...

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: It's alright. If you find her, please inform me as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Yan'er
dialogues.text: Oh, is this a gift? Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's from Hiromi.

dialogues.speaker: Yan'er
dialogues.text: Hiromi... who's that?

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: Sorry. I don't know any officer who catches thieves.

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: Especially idiots. I don't know any of them.

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: However... please thank him for returning the badge.

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: Also, the Uyuu Restaurant seems like a fine place. I will go there for drinks when I am free.

response.speaker: Yan'er
response.text: Go for a few drinks and get to know that idiot along the way.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: So, did you manage to get any news of "Big Sis"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We've spoken, aye.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: What did she say? Don't tell me she's already forgotten about me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She doesn't know a Hiromi.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: But...!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, that's because she can't get to know any public servants.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Idiotic ones least of all.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Uhh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Still, she thinks that...

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: She thinks that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That she can give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like a date, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Eh! Eh!? Is that how you see it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that so strange...?

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: N—No... it's just... I wasn't expecting this response.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go if you won't.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Wha—! No! There's no need for that! I can take care of this myself!

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: But... she didn't mention when she'll "try to get to know me," did she?

choices.text: I'm afraid she couldn't spill the beans then.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: #Yes, you're right... Anyway, you have my thanks, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Perhaps I still need time to digest everything that she said. Well, I can't claim to be disappointed with this answer either way.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Sorry for the trouble. Here's your payment.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't forget, now: "Uyuu Restaurant."

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: I got it. Thank you!

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: #By the way, {NICKNAME}, I wish you all the best here in Inazuma.

choices.text: She is a Treasure Hoarder, after all...

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Yo, outlander! What are you doing sneaking around?

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Don't bother me with anything unimportant, outlander. Otherwise, I'll kindly have you accompany me to the Outlander Affairs Agency.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: I have no idea how you got here, but it's a criminal offense to interfere with a samurai's job.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: The Kanjou Commissioner will punish you severely should he find out.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: So I'd advise you to stay back — for your own safety.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Kanjou Commission?

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: Are you serious? Do you outlanders not fear the Commissioner anymore nowadays?

choices.text: I don't see this place being under Kanjou jurisdiction.

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: You...!

response.speaker: Hiromi
response.text: You're not wrong... But even a samurai has a right to some free time. You outlanders wouldn't understand!

choices.text: You're not on the job right now, are you?
You know, maybe you're the sneaky one here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you waiting for someone?

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: ... So what if I am?

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: If you've got something to say, say it fast. Us Treasure Hoarders, our time's not yours for the wastin'.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about Hiromi...

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: Ah, he's a good lad... But he's a big baby, too. He needs a bit more time to grow.

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: So I say, but in the end, being immature is better than being evil.

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: He has his livelihood and his responsibilities...

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: It's not all his fault either that he's scared to make choices.

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: At least he's still got some choices to make.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry, just asking.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Please don't ask me pointless questions while I'm on duty.

dialogues.speaker: Hiromi
dialogues.text: Come on, please stop bothering me. Please leave.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Please go after those bandits. Don't let me slow you down.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Oh! I see! Then you must be here to help me—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: By your leave!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: What else could it be? I'm one of the Treasure Hoarders, so I'm here for the treasure, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And why won't you go inside?

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: Are you trying to get me killed? It's dangerous inside!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, if someone were to get the treasure first...

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: Hah! What I don't know about can't affect my bottom line.

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: That's a Treasure Hoarder-patented survival technique!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Jeez...

dialogues.speaker: Shun
dialogues.text: Hehe~
